viewing_check: Check rabbit trap makers stamped on plates or jaws (Lane, Sidebottom, Victor, Sheffield marks) and count them; look for a maker name on the vice (Record, Parkinson, Woden, Dawn) and size; lantern maker embossed on font or cap (Dietz, Harvey Shaw & Drake); maker stamps on braces (Spofforth, Sheffield).
